description:
Make your brand or product shine with metallic labels.

Custom metallic labels add a shimmering flair to your advertising designs. You can adhere metallic labels to any type of packaging to promote your product or business. Use them for promotions or giveaways at special events.

 

 

What Colors Are Available?

Metallic label printing adds sparkle to any color. Silver foil is layered beneath CMYK colors during the printing process. The result? Colorful shine!
Whether you create your own design or choose from one of our templates, you can use multiple colors in foil—and even add gradients.

 

How Do I Get Started?

If you have your own design, you can upload your file and our printing experts will check your artwork to make sure it’s print-ready.
Don't have artwork? Use one of our free, downloadable file setup templates. It's easy!

 
What Material and Finish Options Are Available?

Custom metallic labels are printed on 70 lb. sticker stock with a UV coating to protect it from the environment.

 

 

How Do I Use My Own Artwork to Print Metallic Labels?

Here are tips for preparing your artwork files:

  • Images and artwork should be at least 300 dpi
  • Make sure your file is in CMYK color mode
  • 1/8" (0.125") bleed around the trim size
  • 1/8" (0.125") safe zone inside the trim line—1/4" (0.25") from the bleed line

 

Metallic Labels FAQs

Q.Can I see a proof before printing starts?

A.Absolutely! Our prepress experts review all files to help make sure your labels will come out great. Next, you'll receive a PDF proof to check your file before it prints.

Q.Does the printing time include shipment to my address?

A.Printing time is the number of days it takes to produce your order. We can print metallic labels in 5 business days. To find out when your custom labels will arrive, type your ZIP code after selecting "Estimate Shipping Cost and Delivery Date" in our online calculator.
